integrity: Self-contained exact combinatorial and linear-algebraic proof; supplementary finite enumeration is not treated as an infinite proof. The focal public source date is from the original arXiv submission; older supporting literature is separately cited.
limitations: Only uniformly sampled acyclic orientations of K_{2,n}, n>=2. Linear partial correlations, not nonlinear conditional independence. Historical priority and independent verification are unresolved.
title: Signed covariance and precision spectra of uniform acyclic orientations of \(K_{2,n}\)
